<PAGE>
> Agent Foundry Orchestrator E2E tooling - description of the 99-af-e2e fixture area.

The `99-af-e2e/` area is a throwaway fixture region of this vault: it holds artifacts produced by governed-write E2E probes of the Agent Foundry Orchestrator. Nothing under it is long-lived knowledge; its contents exist only to exercise and observe the write-governance pipeline.

Targets under `99-af-e2e/` are not matched by the L2 path rules. Because an unmatched path falls back to the conservative default, the policy evaluator classifies every target under this area as L3-governed, and a governed write to `99-af-e2e/af-l3-gate-probe.md` (this page) is never auto-published — it requires a real Human Gate before it can be published.

Cleanup is not done file-by-file. The fixture area is reset in full by running `fixtures/make-governed-fixture.sh`, which rebuilds the fixture vault from scratch.

This page is itself one of those probe artifacts: its own publish path exercises the L3 Human Gate route described above.
</PAGE>
